info.title: Clockwork API
info.description: Self-hosted automation and task scheduling. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, where the token is either the operator's admin token or an application's API key (`cwk_...`). An application only sees its own tasks and executions; anything else answers 404. Applications cannot use the shell runner. Errors always use the `Error` shape. Webhook deliveries are signed: verify the Clockwork-Signature header (see the WebhookEvent schema).

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Signed event notifications. An application manages its own endpoints; the admin manages anyone's.

get.summary: Server version, available runners and who the caller is

get.description: For an application, only its own tasks; `application_id` is ignored.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the task name

post.description: An application's tasks always belong to it: omit `application_id`. Task names are unique per application, so a create retried after a timeout answers 409 instead of creating a duplicate.

patch.description: Only fields present change. `"schedule": null` removes the schedule. Send `********` for a masked secret to keep the stored value.

delete.summary: Delete a task and its execution history

post.description: Works for paused and unscheduled tasks. Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make the request safe to retry: a repeat with the same key (per application) returns the original execution with 200 and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Up to 255 printable ASCII characters, unique per application

200.description: Replayed: this Idempotency-Key was already used for this task

409.description: This Idempotency-Key was already used for another task

get.description: For an application, only its own executions.

patch.summary: Rename, describe, enable or disable an application
patch.description: Disabling stops the application's API keys from working (403) and its tasks from being scheduled. The default application cannot be renamed or disabled.

delete.summary: Delete an application and its keys
delete.description: Fails with 409 while the application owns tasks, and for the default application.

get.summary: List an application's API keys (without the keys themselves)

post.description: The response is the only time the key is returned. To rotate: create a new key, deploy it, then revoke the old one.

get.description: For an application, only its own; `application_id` is ignored.

post.description: The response contains the signing `secret`, the only time it is returned.

get.summary: Get a webhook endpoint (without its secret)

patch.summary: Change URL, description, event filter or enabled state
patch.description: Disabling pauses delivery: pending deliveries wait and are sent when the endpoint is re-enabled.

delete.summary: Delete an endpoint and its delivery log

post.description: Takes effect immediately, including for retries of earlier events. Returns the new secret, the only time it is shown.

post.summary: Send a webhook.test event to this endpoint
post.description: Sent even if the endpoint is disabled or filters events out.

post.summary: Send a delivery again, with a fresh set of attempts

bearer.description: The admin token, or an application API key (cwk_...)

Forbidden.description: Admin token required, or the application is disabled

NotFound.description: Does not exist, or belongs to another application

Conflict.description: Conflicts with the current state, such as a duplicate name

ValidationFailed.description: One or more fields are invalid; `details` lists each

details.description: Field path to problem, for validation_failed

shell_enabled.description: Whether this caller may create shell tasks

ShellConfig.description: Admin only, and only when the server sets CLOCKWORK_ENABLE_SHELL=true

output.description: HTTP: status_code, content_type, body (first 8 KiB), body_truncated, body_bytes. Shell: exit_code, stdout, stderr (first 16 KiB each) and *_truncated.

retry_at.description: When the next attempt may start, if one was queued

prefix.description: First characters of the key, to tell keys apart

key.description: The API key. Shown only in this response.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing key. Shown only in this response.

id.description: Sent as Clockwork-Delivery; the same on every attempt

last_response.description: First 1 KiB of the last response body

WebhookEvent.description: The JSON body POSTed to endpoints. Headers: Clockwork-Signature (t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>), Clockwork-Event, Clockwork-Event-Id, Clockwork-Delivery.
